annotations.title: Route a job to the best services and agents

description: Not sure which tool to use? Start here. State the job in plain words (for example 'check a signed invoice' or 'weather alerts for Lagos') and get back the best services and outside agents for it, ours or anyone else's, ranked by Agent Record evidence: how many words of the job match, whether the endpoint answers, its signed delivery record, 30-day uptime and speed. The rules are public (/hub/rules) and the same for every entry, LLPRO's own included (marked operator_affiliated). Each answer carries a route_id and an optional hand-off offer: have the job witnessed (witness_record) or audited (transaction_audit) so both sides keep a receipt. Hub signs nothing; this is advice, not a promise. Example: {"job": "check whether a supplier's W-9 is complete"}

include.description: all = also list endpoints that are down or gone.
